messages:
sara: heads up — starting a small slice deploy to prod in 10m (t=3133701234). plan: canary to 5% in us-east, only /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. smoke plan: curl checks + 10 synthetic requests using the slice-a prompts. pinging @kevin for ops coverage.

kevin: oncall for the window. I'll run the smoke and watch p95/errors. rollback tag ready: release/2026-03-17/slice-a. can you paste the exact curl checks? :thumbsup:

sara: quick checks — health: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://prod-api.redwood/v1/health` (expect 200). perf probe: `hey -n 10 -c 2 https://prod-api.redwood/v1/generate` using prompts at `/infra/smoke/prompts/slice-a.json`. also verify embeddings endpoint with 10 short queries.

linh: I'm standing by for metrics. I'll watch token cost/reply, p95 latency, error rate, and GPU utilization. threshold: pause if p95 > 600ms or error_rate > 0.5%. watching for memory spikes too.

mike: FYI — console rollout flag is `canary.sliceA=true`. runbook updated: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/deploy-slice-a (rollback commands + quickchecks).

kevin: kicking off smoke now, will post quick results.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by sara at 3133701294 -> initiating canary slice (5%) in us-east-1.

kevin: smoke results — health 200, /v1/generate p95=180ms, errors=0.0%, /v1/embeddings p95=220ms. logs show no obvious errors. :white_check_mark:

sara: great. plan to promote to 25% in 5m if no regressions. rollback is on-hand.

linh: metrics look clean in the first window. token cost steady. continuing to monitor for 15 more minutes.

kevin: staying in thread and watching alerts. ping me if anything spikes.

mike: small mitigation note — if we see cold-starts >1s, try `kubectl rollout restart svc/generator-slice-a` as a fast mitigation before doing a rollback.

deploy-bot: canary promotion to 25% complete. monitoring window active.

sara: thanks team — tagging this thread for post-rollout follow-up. will close after a 30m green window. :tada:
